text:
maria: Customer reported tool call started failing after we pushed a rename. They call 'invoiceCreate' and get a 404 tool_not_found. Repro included below.

maria: curl repro (customer):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-customer-xxx\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"tool":"invoiceCreate","input":{"amount":100,"currency":"USD"}}'
```

maria: response from API: `{"error":"tool_not_found","message":"No tool matching 'invoiceCreate' (tried exact, casefold, aliases). last_lookup: tool-id=5f3a... not found"}`

jason: can you paste the request-id / account / env from the failing request? is this hosted or dedicated/private?

maria: request-id: req_2026_02_10_2215_77, account: acct_99X, env: private (customer on Redwood Private in eu-west-2, dedicated pool). Customer says this started immediately after we renamed `invoice_create` -> `invoiceCreate` to match their SDK casing.

support-bot: Registry sync job completed at 2026-02-10T03:40:12Z with warnings: "alias-casing: detected lowercase-only alias for tool 5f3a...". See /ops/registry/sync/18923.

eden: quick hypothesis: dedicated pool nodes are still caching the old alias/UUID mapping and our rename created a casing-only alias that wasn't written to all caches. When cache lookup falls through we return tool_not_found instead of trying legacy alias. Can you share server logs from the dedicated nodes for req_2026_02_10_2215_77?

maria: pasted trimmed server logs from the node customer hit: 
```
[2026-02-10T22:15:77Z] req=req_2026_02_10_2215_77 lookup.alias='invoiceCreate' -> MISS cache
[2026-02-10T22:15:77Z] registry.lookup(alias='invoiceCreate') -> 404 (no exact alias)
[2026-02-10T22:15:77Z] registry.lookup(alias='invoice_create') -> 200 -> tool_uuid=5f3a... (but we never map fallback)
[2026-02-10T22:15:77Z] response -> 404 tool_not_found
```

maria: note that registry does have the old lowercase alias `invoice_create` and the new `invoiceCreate` exists in control plane, but dedicated node's registry client returns 404 for the new alias.

backend-sre: that log snippet is helpful. Looks like node cache missed the new alias but resolved the old lowercase alias only when directly queried. Two possibilities: (1) alias rename created a new alias record without invalidating cache TTL on nodes (stale index), or (2) we have a casefolding mismatch where the node normalizes aliases differently than control plane.

eden: repro steps to validate locally (dev):
1) deploy local dedicated runtime with same env var (REGISTRY_CACHE_TTL=300)
2) push alias rename via control-plane: `PUT /internal/aliases/invoice_create -> invoiceCreate`
3) wait 30s, then run: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-test\" -d '{"tool":"invoiceCreate"}' https://local:8443/v1/call`
4) check runtime logs for cache MISS and registry fallback behavior.

maria: Customer cannot change their code to call uuid. Need mitigation that won't require any client change.

backend-sre: immediate mitigation options: 
- run cache purge on the affected dedicated nodes to force alias refresh: `POST /internal/cache/purge?target=node-42&key=aliases`
- add a short-term server-side fallback: when alias lookup fails, try a case-insensitive alias check and legacy aliases for 60s after a rename event.

jason: we should be careful with auto case-insensitive fallbacks (could collide). I'd prefer targeted cache purge + audit of rename propagation logic. Also ensure registry writes set a change-token and push invalidation event to dedicated pools.

maria: customer asked what to do right now. I gave them two options: (A) call tool by UUID (not ideal), (B) ask us to purge caches and confirm. They asked us to do the purge.

elaine: I'll own coordination. Plan:
- infra: run `POST /ops/pools/dedicated/eu-west-2/cache/purge?alias=invoiceCreate` across pool (ETA 15 min).
- infra: if purge doesn't immediately fix, run a one-off registry resync: `POST /ops/registry/resync?force=true` (ETA +30m).
- product/engineers: add a short-term safe fallback in the alias resolver to retry with ASCII-casefolding and try hyphen/underscore variants for 5 minutes after a rename event. We'll limit to exact collisions check to avoid wrong tool selection.
- devex: add a regression test for casing-only rename to CI.

jason: also add monitoring: alert if alias lookup misses exceed threshold during a rename window.

maria: customer confirmed they can wait 30 minutes. Thanks. Please post back when purge done so I can update them. :thumbsup:

support-bot: cache purge job started on pool eu-west-2 at 2026-02-10T22:30:12Z (job id purge_9012).

backend-sre: purge completed on node-42 and node-43 at 2026-02-10T22:32:05Z; verified alias mapping now returns invoiceCreate -> 5f3a...

maria: re-run test from customer environment returned 200 now. Customer confirms success. Marking as escalated -> resolved pending follow-up changes to make renames safer.

elaine: filing follow-up RFC: `registry: strengthen rename propagation and add casing-tolerant fallback window`. I'll add owners and timeline. Assigning infra task to `backend-sre` and engineering task to `eden` ETA 2 weeks.

jason: nice root-cause writeup opportunity. Please include exact log lines and job ids in the postmortem.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll notify customer and close the ticket after RFC is tracked. :white_check_mark:
